description: The voices an engine can speak as — the voice the caller actually hears. Use an id from here as voice.tts.voice (composed engines) or voice.realtime.voice (realtime engines). Never invent a voice id; an unknown one is rejected. The account's own cloned voices (create_voice_clone) come first, with category cloned. A response with stale: true means the provider could not be reached and this is the last known list. No scope needed beyond a valid key.

engine.description: An engine id from list_engines, e.g. "classic", "sarvam", "gemini_live", "deepgram_agent", "openai_live", "openai_realtime", "grok_voice".

name: list_engine_voices
title: List an engine's speaker voices
